summary: Completed testing of 'Info - Prochain événement' feature for La Bague Impériale. All backend APIs (POST, GET, DELETE /api/prochain-evenement-info) working correctly. Frontend Messages.js template with cyan icon visible and functional. Dashboard Membre displays prochain événement info correctly with badge, date, and lieu.
seed_data_creation: Test info restored: repas on 2026-05-20 at A Conca D'Oru, Ajaccio
context_for_next_testing_agent: Info - Prochain événement feature complete. Test data exists in DB (repas 20 mai 2026 at A Conca D'Oru). To test: Messages > click 'Info - Prochain événement' > Modal opens with type/date/lieu form. Dashboard Membre shows info when no official event exists.

GET /api/prochain-evenement-info.details: Returns active info with id, type_evenement, date, lieu, actif fields

POST /api/prochain-evenement-info.details: Creates new info, deactivates old ones, returns success with info object

DELETE /api/prochain-evenement-info/{id}.details: Deactivates info (sets actif=false), returns 404 for non-existent id

POST /api/messages (info_prochain_evenem.details: Sends message to members with info_prochain_evenement type

Messages.js - Template 'Info - Prochain.details: Template visible with cyan icon, opens special modal (not standard message modal)

Messages.js - Info Modal.details: Modal contains: type selection (apéro/repas), date picker (shadcn calendar), lieu input, message preview, send button

Messages.js - data-testid attributes.details: Found: info-type-apero, info-type-repas, info-date-picker, info-lieu-input, send-info-btn

Dashboard Membre - Prochain événement se.details: Displays info with cyan styling: badge (Repas/Apéro), date (mercredi 20 mai 2026), lieu (A Conca D'Oru, Ajaccio), 'Plus d'informations à venir...'

notes: Feature workflow: Admin goes to Messages > clicks 'Info - Prochain événement' > fills form (type, date, lieu) > clicks 'Envoyer l'info'. This creates the info in DB and sends message to all members. Info displays on Dashboard Membre until official event is created.
